title: A Extraction for the Protocol
premise: Rafael Ishikawa, a disgraced intelligence analyst haunted by a botched operation that killed a colleague, receives calls on an unregistered burner from Elena Vasquez — the colleague he watched die. She is alive, embedded in the Protocol, a shadow consortium planning to assassinate delegates at an upcoming Geneva summit and replace them with controlled assets. To stop them, Rafael must extract Elena and deliver to the summit's security chief the Protocol's one true secret: the identity of its founder, a man sitting inside his own former agency. Betrayed by handlers on both sides, Rafael trades the secret at gunpoint in the summit's undercroft, exposing the founder and shattering the Protocol, then walks away with Elena into a life neither of them can fully trust but both finally choose.
about_author: Ivo Quintana is the pen name of a former logistics consultant who spent a decade moving sensitive cargo through three continents before turning to fiction. He writes thrillers about people who discover that the systems they served were never designed to protect them.

chapters.title: The Phone That Shouldn't Ring
chapters.summary: Rafael Ishikawa, insomnia-wrecked and blacklisted after 'the incident,' finds a burner phone sealed in his mail that no sender will claim. When it rings, the voice is Elena Vasquez's — the analyst he watched die two years ago. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: dread curdling into impossible hope.

chapters.title: A Voice from the Grave
chapters.summary: Elena proves her identity with details only she could know, including how she really survived the Vienna operation and who abandoned her there. She warns Rafael he's already flagged as a liability. POV: Rafael, intercut with his memory of the incident. Emotional beat: guilt reignited as obsession.

chapters.title: Three Agencies, No Home
chapters.summary: Rafael retraces his firings and realizes each dismissal followed the same pattern — someone inside was pruning anyone who touched the Vienna file. He tests his old contacts; one agrees to meet, then doesn't show. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: the loneliness of belonging nowhere.

chapters.title: Dead Drop in the Rain
chapters.summary: Elena directs him to a dead drop containing the Protocol's public face: shell companies funneling security contracts for the Geneva summit. A surveillance team burns the drop minutes after he leaves. POV: Rafael, with a cold interlude from the hunter, Marek. Emotional beat: hunted for the first time since Vienna.

chapters.title: Marek's Ledger
chapters.summary: Introducing Marek Osei, the Protocol's extraction specialist, who keeps a private ledger of everyone he's erased. He reports Rafael's activation to a handler known only as the Confessor. POV: Marek. Emotional beat: professional detachment hiding a crack of doubt.

chapters.title: What Died in Vienna
chapters.summary: Rafael finally tells Elena what he believes happened: their own chain of command sold the team. Elena corrects him — it was worse, and she has proof, but it's inside the Protocol's Geneva safehouse. POV: alternating Rafael/Elena phone calls. Emotional beat: shared guilt becoming shared purpose.

chapters.title: The Confessor's Offer
chapters.summary: The Confessor contacts Rafael directly, offering reinstatement and absolution if he delivers Elena. Rafael pretends to consider while recording everything. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: temptation — the old belonging dangled like bait.

chapters.title: Safehouse Seven
chapters.summary: Rafael infiltrates Safehouse Seven posing as a contract auditor and comes face to face with Elena — alive, changed, armed. Their reunion is a knife's edge of trust. They copy the proof: a ledger naming the Protocol's founder by codename. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: reunion as confrontation.

chapters.title: The Codename
chapters.summary: The ledger names the founder 'LANTERN.' Cross-referencing access patterns from his agency years, Rafael narrows LANTERN to three men — all mentors, all present at Vienna. POV: Rafael, spiraling. Emotional beat: identity crisis — his whole career built by the enemy.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: Marek's team hits Rafael's apartment; he escapes with nothing but the copied ledger and a burn wound. Elena extracts him via a freight yard, and they run together for the first time. POV: Rafael and Marek alternating. Emotional beat: the past literally burning behind him.

chapters.title: Trains and Ghosts
chapters.summary: On a night train to Geneva, Elena confesses she let the world believe she died to escape LANTERN's reach — and that she used Rafael's grief as cover. He rages, then understands. POV: Elena. Emotional beat: betrayal transmuted into forgiveness.

chapters.title: The Summit Takes Shape
chapters.summary: Geneva locks down for the summit. The Protocol's plan surfaces: substitute delegates during a ceremonial transfer using cloned credentials. Rafael sees the kill window — and where the secret must be delivered. POV: Rafael, tactical. Emotional beat: clarity sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: An Old Handler's Debt
chapters.summary: Rafael blackmails his former handler, Dana Whitfield, into getting him a summit credential. She agrees — then quietly sells his location to the Confessor to save herself. POV: Dana. Emotional beat: complicity and self-loathing.

chapters.title: Undercroft Rehearsal
chapters.summary: Posing as a technician, Rafael maps the summit undercroft where the substitution will occur. He and Elena plan the exchange: the LANTERN identity for summit security chief Amara Diallo's ear — and protection. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: fragile hope, meticulously planned.

chapters.title: Marek Breaks Ranks
chapters.summary: Ordered to erase Elena before the summit, Marek instead confronts her and learns his own family's deaths were Protocol-ordered leverage. He defects with a piece of the operational timeline. POV: Marek. Emotional beat: vengeance finding a conscience.

chapters.title: Whitfield's Price
chapters.summary: Dana's tip leads the Confessor's team to the safehouse. Elena is taken; Rafael escapes with the ledger because Marek covers his exit and is gravely wounded. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: helplessness — the incident repeating itself.

chapters.title: Negotiating with Ghosts
chapters.summary: The Confessor offers a trade: Elena for the LANTERN name, at the undercroft, mid-summit. Rafael knows it's a trap and goes anyway, carrying a forged version of the secret as insurance. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: fear mastered, not absent.

chapters.title: The Undercroft Exchange
chapters.summary: The exchange collapses into violence. Rafael reveals the real name aloud — Director Aldous Renner, his first mentor — broadcasting it to Diallo's hidden recorders. Protocol shooters open fire; Marek, arriving broken but breathing, turns the tide. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: climax — truth as a weapon fired at point-blank range.

chapters.title: Renner Unmasked
chapters.summary: Diallo locks down the summit; Renner is arrested in the delegation hall while trying to trigger the substitution himself. Elena, freed in the chaos, chooses not to shoot the Confessor — justice over revenge. POV: Elena. Emotional beat: restraint as victory.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: In closed sessions, Rafael testifies, surrendering the ledger and his last claim to the intelligence world. His record is quietly rehabilitated; nothing feels like absolution until Elena sits beside him uninvited. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: justice outside the law, imperfect but real.

chapters.title: Sleep Through the Night
chapters.summary: Weeks later, in a coastal town far from any capital, Rafael sleeps a full night for the first time since Vienna. He wakes to find Elena making coffee, the burner phone retired in a drawer. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: peace earned, not granted.

chapters.title: A New Protocol
chapters.summary: Epilogue: Marek, recovering, mails Rafael a single page from his ledger — blank now except for one line: two names choosing to exist off every list. Rafael and Elena decide what to build next, together, unwritten. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: belonging chosen, identity self-made.
